reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 55 for the 220-receiver graph. Lower bound: an independent set of size 55 (check passed). Upper bound: linear code M = I + A over F_3 (p=3, c=1) of length 55, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true; one code tried. Compared with baselines: accuracy matches cpsat_alpha (55, proven), frac_cover (~55) and kushagra_agent (55/55 exact, field 3); beats cpsat_cover (65, unproven at 120 s) and f2_minrank_sat (no value, lower 54). On time the agent loses badly: wall_s 34.966 (llm_s 34.924, compute_s only 0.042) versus kushagra_agent 0.033 s and cpsat_alpha 0.608 s for the lower bound. Nothing suspicious; the hypothesis K(12,3) is consistent with all summary numbers.
